description: This file implements the MediaPipeline class and related functions for media playback management, including state handling, media source attachment, playback controls, and notifications within the Rialto media client framework.

classes.name: MediaPipeline
classes.description: Implementation of the media pipeline handling media playback, source management, state updates, and notifications within the Rialto client.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type with given MIME type and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the pipeline by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback and resets state.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position if in a valid state.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: handleSetPosition
methods.description: Handles setting the position, invalidates need data requests.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window dimensions.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Handles need media data requests based on current state.

methods.name: handleHaveData
methods.description: Processes haveData requests, finds corresponding need data request.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline, handling encryption and frame writing.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Sets mute state.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves mute state.

methods.name: discardNeedDataRequest
methods.description: Discards a need data request by ID.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline client.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on network or playback state.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notifies client of playback state change.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notifies client of position change.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notifies client of network state change.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Handles need media data notification for a source.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Updates application state and clears need data requests if not running.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notifies client of QoS info.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notifies client of buffer underflow.
